evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: CLM-WATERWAYS-EXPEDITION-CONCEPTION courageously attributes conception to Jamie while its boundary and anti-claims reserve raft construction, operation, completion, and route claims.
CLM-WATERWAYS-GREAT-ACCOMMODATIONS-PROGRAM names Jamie's spearheading and facilitation while explicitly crediting Suzanne Hogan's outreach and protecting participant contributions.
CLM-OPEN-HOUSE-PARTICIPATORY-DESIGN distinguishes Jamie's initiation and tending from housemates' work, participant agency, and communal governance.
CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-ADVOCACY states Jamie's rallying and sustained coalition advocacy directly but rejects sole leadership and individual causality for repeal.
CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE and CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE hold causal wording and specify exactly what current evidence does not establish.

docs/knowledge-bank/projects/waterways-and-participatory-art.md and docs/knowledge-bank/projects/nyc-artist-coalition-research.md preserve the same action, contribution, outcome, and causality distinctions in editorial prose.
findings: Direct actions are stated with unusually strong, source-matched verbs: conceived, spearheaded, initiated and tended, started organizing, rallied, and advocated.

Collective credit is substantive rather than ceremonial: Suzanne Hogan, Fredenberg, housemates, participants, coalition actors, Council actors, sponsors, and government institutions remain visible where relevant.

Public outcomes are not silently converted into Jamie's achievements. Repeal, Office creation, town-hall consequences, participation impact, expedition completion, and M.A.R.C.H. status remain bounded or held.
The observation limitations, claim boundaries, anti-claims, and research success criteria reinforce one another with exceptional consistency.
evals.recommended_next_move: Retain the present calibrated wording; use RT-NYCAC-CABARET-CONTRIBUTION and RT-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION to earn any future causal language while explicitly recording collaborator and institutional credit.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: CLM-WATERWAYS-GREAT-ACCOMMODATIONS-PROGRAM states Jamie's spearheading, outreach collaboration, facilitation, program forms, and community-connection purpose in hiring-legible language.
CLM-OPEN-HOUSE-PARTICIPATORY-DESIGN makes Jamie's operating role concrete: he initiated and tended a ten-day participatory structure while responsibility and decisions remained communal.
CLM-NYCAC-FIRE-CODE-STUDY-GROUPS and CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-ADVOCACY preserve strong direct actions without diluting them merely because outcomes remain unproven.

RT-NYCAC-COFOUNDER-EVIDENCE, RT-NYCAC-CABARET-CONTRIBUTION, RT-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION, and RT-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-MARCH-OUTCOME keep high-value claims visible, prioritized, bounded, and researchable.

docs/knowledge-bank/promotion-slate.md consistently classifies matured records as future features or supporting proof and routes the town hall, co-founder role, causal contributions, M.A.R.C.H. outcomes, and CallNYC metric to further research.
docs/knowledge-bank/projects/nyc-artist-coalition-research.md explicitly preserves the NPR item as a retrieval candidate and states that no claim relies on unread content.
findings: The bank presents Jamie as an actor without apology or inflation and explains the practical ends: connecting river communities, sustaining participatory conditions, improving venue safety knowledge, preserving community-driven cultural spaces, and creating dialogue with public institutions.
The promotion slate is exceptionally useful editorially: it distinguishes lead-feature potential, supporting proof, and research-before-promotion while giving a reason for each placement.
Slate recommendations match canonical claim maturity and boundaries; no held causal or role claim is misrepresented as promotion-ready.
Research tasks have source-specific success criteria and next actions, so unresolved value is preserved as actionable inquiry rather than weakened prose.
This meets the exceptional threshold for specificity, source discipline, professional legibility, calibrated confidence, and future editorial usefulness.
evals.recommended_next_move: Prioritize RT-NYCAC-COFOUNDER-EVIDENCE and RT-NYCAC-CABARET-CONTRIBUTION because they offer the highest potential gain in hiring legibility; promote nothing stronger until their collaborator, chronology, and public-record criteria are satisfied.
